what: Answer pins for a cache-only reproduction (tools/run_jev_ablation.py --jev cache --answer-pins this file --pin-run <run>): where the cache file holds two answers for one request (the same request sent twice at the same moment by two takes running at once, concurrency 2), a cache-mode run would give the later answer everywhere; each pin gives back the answer the recorded run used at that arm, take and window. response and latency_ms are copied from the cache file line cache_line (0-based).
